messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: P1 — Elevated 5xx rate from serving runtime. Alerting on kvcache_continuous_batcher error spike (toolcall / structured-output path). Auto-escalation to oncall.
ops-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-4821 triggered, routed to oncall (leila).
leila: I'm looking. Error rate jumped ~00:07 UTC, tail latency up, several customers seeing 500s on generate endpoints. Initial graphs: https://grafana/redwood/d/serve/kvcache?orgId=1
david: logs show "batch split invalidation" followed by "kv_get miss" and then immediate re-queue of small batches. Looks like tool-calling responses with structured JSON are blowing the continuous batcher because of newline/sep tokens?
marcus: This was my recent change in function-calling serializer (escape vs raw). Could be changing tokenization boundaries and causing the batcher to think sequence prefixes differ. Rolling back patch?
leila: Can we triage scope — is traffic concentrated on hosted API or Dedicated?
kim: Support: multiple hosted customers on prod saw 30-60% increase in errors. No Dedicated reports yet. Customers A,B reported timeouts and repeated 5xx.
leila: Action plan: 1) Disable continuous batching for the tool-calling path (hotfix TTL 30m). 2) Pin serializer -> rollback if necessary. 3) Roll canary for fix and monitor. Anyone object?
david: I can push a hotfix to routing to force batch_size=1 for requests with tools_enabled=true and structured_output=true. That should stop fragmentation. Command to stage:
```
# staging route change
curl -XPOST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/routes/force-config -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","force_batch_size":1,"match":{"tools":true,"structured_output":true}}'
```
leila: Do it. Make sure to set tag = hotfix/178005.
david: Pushed hotfix to prod; routes updated. ops-bot: deployment prod/route-hotfix-178005 started.
ops-bot: deployment prod/route-hotfix-178005 successful in 6s.
leila: Monitoring metrics — errors dropping. 5xx rate down from 18% -> 3% in last 2 minutes. Latency back to baseline. Kim, please notify affected customers with ETA and mitigation note.
kim: Notifying customers A,B. Message: "We've applied an interim routing hotfix reducing errors; root cause investigation ongoing; will follow with postmortem."
jordan: I'm on deck for handoff in 20m. If you're not confident in rollback plan, leave notes.
marcus: I'm opening revert PR for the serializer change (revert/serializer-escape) and a test that verifies token boundaries for function outputs. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/1092
leila: Next steps: - keep hotfix for 30m while we validate. - run synthetics for the toolcall path (david/marcus). - get a small canary of serializer revert out if tests pass. - prepare incident page for customers. I'll leave the incident open and hand to jordan at 20:10 UTC.
eva-cs: Logged customer impact on incident tracker: high for hosted customers, zero data exposure, customers affected: A,B,C (retry loops caused more requests).
jordan: Taking over oncall. leila — anything outstanding?
leila: Documented everything in the runbook thread, pinned timeline, metrics links. If error remains after hotfix TTL, escalate to full rollback and open infra maintenance window. I'll join postmortem.
jordan: Acknowledged. I'll monitor rollback gate and keep paging on any regression. :thumbsup:
